svg.aria-label: PagedAttention: each request sees contiguous logical blocks of 4 tokens; a per-request block table maps them to physical blocks scattered anywhere in one preallocated GPU pool; blocks are allocated only when needed and freed when a request ends.
svg.text: PagedAttention: the KV cache in fixed-size blocks
block size = 4 tokens · each slot holds that token's K and V for every layer and head
① Logical view (what each request sees)
Decode step for A: the query is “and”.
The kernel follows A's table (7 → 1 → 3) and reads
A's next 3 tokens fill block 3; the 4th token takes a free block (e.g. 0) and appends “3 → 0” to A's table.
when B finishes, blocks 5 and 2 go back to the free list and a waiting request can use them at the next step.
waste is at most one partly filled block per request, versus reserving max_len contiguous slots per request.
two tables may point at the same block (same prompt prefix, n > 1 samples); copy-on-write when they diverge.
